classification.theory_summary: Speculates Mallworld may relate to internet/consumer-research simulation; includes alternative theories involving wireless signals/balloons.
classification.question_topic: Whether others' Mallworld has recurring 'fads' (specific products/stores) that come and go

meta.author_theory: Mentions speculative explanations (consumer-research sim / internet made physical) while stating they are not certain.

locations.location_name: weirdly empty fad store (toy electric train sets)

qualities.raw_description: Stores are 'weirdly empty' and sell only different varieties of one fad product; 'blank white walls', 'bare fluorescent lighting', 'some racks or tables down the middle of the floor sparsely populated with the product', and 'an empty display case with the cash register on it in a corner'; 'family run and kind of shady or dangerous, like they're a front for something.'

interactions.description: Dreamer is in a single-product fad store; if the dreamer opens a box, the owners react angrily.

entities_involved.description: Usually a husband-and-wife team running the store; 'quick to anger if you open a box or something.'

interactions.transaction_item: small toy electric train sets (about N scale), very cheap-looking; packaging with 'Chinese bootleg aesthetic' and 'totally off the wall' labeling

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a question/theory discussion, but includes recurring in-dream retail environment details (store layout, lighting, staffing, product characteristics). Temporal aspect is limited to 'fads that come and go' without specific timing.
